resources.string: Use your phone as a microphone for your PC over Wi-Fi.
Your phone is sending silence. Check the microphone mute or privacy setting, and make sure no other app is using the microphone.
Enter a valid IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.23.
Microphone permission is required to stream audio.
Could not start the microphone. Check that no other app is using it, then try again.
Could not send audio. Check that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network, then try again.
Android did not allow Phone Mic to run in the background. Keep the app open and try again.
Something went wrong while streaming. Please try again.
Shows when Phone Mic is sending audio to your PC.
Android may stop Phone Mic when the screen is off. Allow Phone Mic to run without battery restrictions so it keeps streaming.
Phone Mic needs to record your voice and send it directly to your PC over your local Wi-Fi network. Audio is not recorded or uploaded anywhere else.
Android is blocking microphone access. Open the app settings and allow Microphone, then come back and press Start streaming.

Phone Mic keeps streaming while you use other apps or turn off the screen. A notification lets you mute or stop it. If your phone stops the stream, set battery usage for Phone Mic to Unrestricted in Android settings.
Audio goes directly to your PC on your local network. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
